description: This file defines an abstract interface and a concrete implementation for a repository managing 'Project' entities in a Flutter application, interfacing with Firestore database.

classes.name: IProjectRepository
classes.description: An abstract interface for project repository operations, including streaming, retrieving, upserting, and deleting projects.

classes.name: ProjectRepository
classes.description: A concrete implementation of IProjectRepository interfacing with Firestore to manage Project entities.

methods.name: streamProjects
methods.description: Streams a list of projects for a user, ordered by 'sortOrder'.

methods.name: streamProject
methods.description: Streams a single project by ID for a user.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a project by ID for a user, returning null if not found.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Inserts or updates a project in Firestore and returns its ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID for a user.

methods.name: _requireUid
methods.description: Private method to ensure a user ID is available for repository operations.
